state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 5 (the fixes).** Stage 4's review is whole (`docs/perf/performance-review.md`).

**`Core\Request::headers()` is linear.** `grouped_fields` in `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/request.rs` searched every name already seen for each header line. A name-to-group map replaces that search. The `request/headers` ladder now reads the list 200 times per request, so the clock sees it. Its clock slope went from 1.46–1.77 to 0.92–0.97 (`docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *What got better*). Before the change it was `invalid` on 3 runs of 4, because the clock was noise and a `serve` ladder has no callgrind fallback.

**`numbers/bigint-mul.nvs` stays `unclear`, and that is judged.** `num-bigint` uses Toom-3 above 256 digits. Each step now squares sixteen sizes spaced evenly in ratio from n/3 to n. Callgrind's local slopes are 1.37, 1.23 and 1.32: all under the 1.7 bound, but they differ by more than `AGREE`. It is recorded under *Benches to look at*. `unclear` does not fail `scaling --check`, which exits 1 only on `grows` or `invalid` (`tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:1016`).

**`bun nv scaling --check` is green**: 49 flat, 1 unclear (`bigint-mul`), on the release binary with this fix.

The perf ledger is current: `bun nv proofs --record-perf` re-measured 347 stale records, and `docs/perf/members.md` is regenerated.

**7 gap records owned by `performance-pass`** keep `owners --closes performance-pass` red. `bun nv owners --closes performance-pass` lists them.

**The driver's stage-2 check `scaling --iterations --check` timed out after 1800 s.** Not checked whether one bench hangs or the whole roster is just slow.

The release binary `target/release/nvs.exe` was rebuilt this session with the `headers()` fix.
